hazards.evidence: A soft dog bed containing a large bone/toy and a separate metal pet bowl sit directly on the front concrete walkway in the approach to the steps, creating hard and soft trip obstacles underfoot for a walker user.
A raised wooden/brass door sill/threshold is visible at the base of the front door, which a walker or foot must clear when entering after surgery.
